sections.label: Singapore Community Wakaf update
sections.summary: An Advisory Panel chaired by Mr Abu Bakar Mohd Nor was set up to recommend how to galvanise community involvement and operationalise the WMS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development and Minister-in-charge for Muslim Affairs whether he can provide an update on the Singapore Community Wakaf (SCW) and plans to support the establishment of the SCW including any legislative or regulatory changes and public awareness campaign.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This endowment project is intended to create a sustainable income to support our religious institutions, asatizah development and community programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since then, an Advisory Panel chaired by Mr Abu Bakar Mohd Nor, a MUIS Council Member and also Deputy President of the Singapore Malay Chamber of Commerce and Industry, or SMCCI, has been set up to recommend how to galvanise community involvement and operationalise the WMS.

sections.label: Panel report on WMS
sections.summary: The panel submitted a report on proposed key thrusts and workstreams for WMS development, and the recommendations are being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Following the engagement sessions, the panel has submitted a report on the proposed key thrusts and workstreams for the development of WMS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: I am reviewing the panel’s recommendations and details will be shared in the next few months.

sections.label: Wakaf law changes study
sections.summary: Laws may need to be changed so the WMS prevents disputes, an area to be studied, and the last community wakaf was in 1978.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Even laws may need to be changed to ensure that moving forward, the WMS will prevent such disputes from arising in the first place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This is another area that we need to study, outside what the recommendations are for the WMS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I would also note that the last wakaf that we received from our community was in 1978.
